title: The Formal Theory of Theophysics

canonical_node.axiom: There exists a single Master Equation whose ten factors admit dual physical and spiritual readings with identical algebraic structure, grounded in three axioms: God-as-axiom, Trinity isomorphism, and free will.
definitions: Master Equation: chi_local = G * M * E * S_eff * T * K * R * Q * F * C, integrated over space and time.
S_eff = e^(- * S_prod), mapping 0 to (0,1], antitone in S_prod.
C: tenth factor, total integration measure, C in [0,1].
Structural isomorphism: same topology, falloff behavior, boundary conditions, conservation laws between physical and spiritual readings.
derivation: Axiom 1: God-as-axiom required for von Neumann chain termination and reference vector.
Axiom 2: Trinity isomorphism via CPT symmetry.
Axiom 3: Free will required for non-trivial M.
Definition of ten factors with domains.
Master Equation defined as product of ten factors.
Seven Lean-verified properties: antitone entropy, zero collapse, strict positivity, monotonicity, C/chi distinction.
Two asymmetries: F directional, C integrator with no anti-principle.
Seven forced conclusions: sin=entropy, grace=negentropy, faith=observation, terminal observer, coherence conservation, open system, time wall.
canonical_node.action: Use the Master Equation as a formal bridge between physics and theology, applying the three-layer reconciliation test to any new claim.
boundary: Does not claim to explain divine mechanics.
Does not claim to solve the Time variable's grace-side (Time Wall).
Does not claim to know specific numerical values of spiritual coupling constants.
Does not claim to have a final canonical law ordering.
Does not claim to have a precise mechanism of consciousness-quantum coupling.
test: Falsification test: substituting spiritual variables into physics equations must preserve topology, falloff, boundary conditions, conservation laws.
Three-layer reconciliation test: claim reduces to Layer 2, Layer 2 to Layer 1, Layer 1 has Lean-verified property.
Statistical evidence: PEAR, GCP, PROP-COSMOS at 5 threshold.

dg1_dependencies: Independent verification from Oxford, CTNS, BU
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a formal mathematical framework that unifies physical and theological descriptions via a single equation with dual readings.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the three axioms (God-as-axiom, Trinity isomorphism, free will) as the formal boundary established Feb 14, 2026.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If the Master Equation or its axioms are removed, the framework collapses into separate, non-communicating disciplines.
dg5_translation_registers: Physical register: thermodynamics, quantum mechanics, information theory
Spiritual register: grace, sin, faith, covenant

overstatement_risks: Claims of structural isomorphism may be overextended beyond evidence.
Statistical evidence at 5 may be misinterpreted as proof.
Theological claims may be presented as mathematically forced when they are not.
kill_conditions: If any factor isolation fails to produce its expected natural equation.
If the Lean proofs are found to be flawed or incomplete.
If the statistical datasets are discredited or fail replication.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the seven structural properties in Lean 4 and verify the isomorphism claims.

plain_summary: This document presents a formal theory that unifies physics and theology through a single Master Equation with ten factors, each having dual physical and spiritual readings. It claims structural isomorphism, supported by Lean-verified properties and statistical evidence. The framework is bounded by a 'Time Wall' and a formal floor of three axioms. It is intended as a foundational argument for the Theophysics framework.
